## Rigor checklist
- [ ] I clearly separated **proven** claims from **conjectured/heuristic** ones.
- [ ] I cited sources for factual/technical claims.
- [ ] If I claim a resolution, I linked a peer-reviewed or widely-accepted reference.
- [ ] I tried to break my own argument and noted where it is weakest.
